open_items: Wire canonical hashing into later model-root, review, verification, export and analyzer domains without implicit field exclusion. No complete feature/release approval is claimed.

oracle.requirement_contract: SpecRoad MUSS für Hashbildung JSON Canonicalization Scheme verwenden und den resultierenden Byte-String mit SHA-256 hashen.
oracle.scope: Full-value RFC-8785/SHA-256 primitive; stable Unicode and exact decimal-token policy. Application-specific projections and complete command integration remain later work.

preconditions: Trusted JSON values or original UTF-8 object bytes; no writes or external execution.
steps: Canonicalize valid values and hash the resulting UTF-8 bytes; reject invalid and lossy data without altering inputs.
